description: This file defines React components and helper functions for a UI dashboard related to PII (Personally Identifiable Information) data management, including filters, actions, and entity lists.

methods.name: formatEntityName
methods.description: Replaces underscores with spaces in a given string to format entity names.

methods.name: getActionIcon
methods.description: Returns the corresponding icon component based on the action string ('MASK' or 'BLOCK').
